Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
7:42 AM

National Museum, Janpath, New Delhi, is open today, Sat 24 Oct, from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Tue to Fri it is open 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Sat and Sun 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an ID card. This is from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page.

Open the Indian Railways IRCTC website and check the train timings from New Delhi to Agra tomorrow morning
7:45 AM

IRCTC blocked foo, so these come from another site. Daily trains to Agra Cantt on Sun 25 Oct: Shatabdi 12002 from New Delhi, 6:00 AM to 7:50 AM (chair car); Taj Express 12280 from New Delhi, 6:55 AM to 9:25 AM; Punjab Mail 12138 from New Delhi, 5:10 AM to 8:10 AM (sleeper and AC). Vande Bharat 22470 (Hazrat Nizamuddin, 6:00 AM to 7:40 AM) and Gatimaan 12050 (Hazrat Nizamuddin, 8:10 AM to 9:50 AM) run on selected days. I could not confirm that they run on Sunday.
